'''Gabriela Gustava Hässel de Menéndez''' (15 October 1927 – 4 July 2009) was an Argentine bryologist who worked in [[liverwort]]s and [[hornwort]]s. Originally a botany professor at the [[Faculty of Pharmacy and Biochemistry, University of Buenos Aires]], she left to become a [[National Scientific and Technical Research Council]] (CONICET) researcher and was head of the [[Bernardino Rivadavia Natural Sciences Argentine Museum]]'s [[cryptogamy]] division from 1962 until 2000. She was a 1962 [[Guggenheim Fellow]] and received a 1983 [[Konex Award]].

==Biography==
Hässel was born on 15 October 1927 in [[Quilmes]], a city south of Buenos Aires.<ref name="GF" /> Originally studying natural sciences at the [[Faculty of Exact and Natural Sciences]], she decided to switch to biology after one of the professors there, {{ill|Alberto Castellanos|es|Alberto Castellanos (botánico)}}, suggested the idea.<ref name="BSA" /> She obtained her licentiate in 1952 and doctorate in natural sciences in 1959.<ref name="GF" /> She was also a 1953-1954 [[German Academic Exchange Service]] postgraduate student at the Institute of Botany at the [[Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München]].<ref name="GF" /><ref name="BSA" />

In 1948<ref name="BSA" /> or 1949,<ref name="GF" /> Hässel started as an unpaid assistant at the botany department of the [[Bernardino Rivadavia Natural Sciences Argentine Museum]], working in a herbarium without any reference works or [[movable type]]s.<ref name="BSA" /> After receiving an official appointment at the museum in 1956, she served as head of the museum's [[cryptogamy]] division from 1962 until 2000.<ref name="BSA" /> As division head, she presided over a spike in recorded specimens and restructured the cryptogamic herbarium.<ref name="BSA" /> In 2002, she was made an honorary curator at the museum.<ref name="BSA" />

After working as a laboratory head at the [[Faculty of Pharmacy and Biochemistry, University of Buenos Aires]] from 1955 to 1957, Hässel de Menéndez became a professor of botany there in 1961.<ref name="GF" /> In 1962, she resigned her professor position to become a [[National Scientific and Technical Research Council]] researcher, serving until her death as well as within the Biological Sciences Advisory Committee.<ref name="BSA" /> She was a 1974 [[Royal Society University Research Fellow]], researching the [[British Antarctic Survey]]'s South Georgia collections.<ref name="BSA" /> She received a 2008 CONICET Gold Medal in honour of her becoming the first person to get a CONICET scholarship.<ref name="BSA" />

Hässel de Menéndez's work in bryology included [[liverwort]]s and [[hornwort]]s.<ref name="BSA" /> She had dozens of solo publications, as well as specimens collected from dozens of research trips.<ref name="BSA" /> In 1962,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Gabriela Hässel de Menéndez |url=https://www.gf.org/fellows/gabriela-hassel-de-menendez/ |access-date=2025-07-18 |website=Guggenheim Fellowships}}</ref> she was awarded a [[Guggenheim Fellowship]] to study liverwort taxonomy.<ref name="GF">{{Cite book |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=_6TPWii3-WAC |title=Reports of the Secretary and Treasurer |publisher=John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation |year=1961 |page=165 |archive-date=16 September 2024 |access-date=19 July 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240916025210/https://books.google.com/books?id=_6TPWii3-WAC |url-status=live }}</ref> She won the 1970 Cristobal Hicken Award,<ref name="BSA" /> and in 1983, she received a [[Konex Award]] in Botany and Paleobotany.<ref name="Konex" /> She was a board member of the Latin American Bryological Society from 1986 to 1988, in addition to being instrumental in promoting its creation.<ref name="BSA" /> In a 1988 article in the {{ill|Journal of the Hattori Botanical Laboratory|es|italics=y}}, {{ill|Robbert Gradstein|nl}} and {{ill|Riclef Grolle|de}} named the liverwort genus ''[[Haesselia]]'' in honour of Hässel de Menéndez, calling her "the [founder of] high standard [[hepaticology]] in Latin America".<ref>{{cite book | last=Burkhardt | first=Lotte | title=Eine Enzyklopädie zu eponymischen Pflanzennamen | trans-title=Encyclopedia of eponymic plant names | publisher=Botanic Garden and Botanical Museum, Freie Universität Berlin | year=2022 | isbn=978-3-946292-41-8 | url=https://doi.org/10.3372/epolist2022 | format=pdf | language=German | location=Berlin | doi=10.3372/epolist2022 | access-date=January 27, 2022 | page=H-4 | archive-date=31 August 2023 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230831232306/https://www.bgbm.org/de/eine-enzyklopadie-zu-eponymischen-pflanzennamen | url-status=live }}</ref> As part of her final publication, a ''Nova Hedwigia'' article titled "Catalogue of Marchantiophyta and Anthocerotophyta of Southern South America", she did indexing work for a bryology bibliography going back five decades.<ref name="BSA">{{Cite journal |last=Rubies |first=Marta F. |date=2009 |title=Gabriela Gustava Hässel de Menéndez: 1927 - 2009 |url=https://www.scielo.org.ar/scielo.php?script=sci_abstract&pid=S1851-23722009000200019&lng=es&nrm=iso&tlng=es |journal=Boletín de la Sociedad Argentina de Botánica |language=es |volume=44 |issue=3-4 |pages=453–453 |issn=1851-2372 |via=SciELO}}</ref>

Hässel de Menéndez died on 4 July 2009.<ref name="Konex">{{Cite web |title=Gabriela Hässel de Menéndez |url=https://www.fundacionkonex.org/b1369-gabriela-hssel-de-menendez |access-date=2025-07-18 |website=Fundación Konex |language=es |archive-date=16 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250516195831/https://www.fundacionkonex.org/b1369-gabriela-hssel-de-menendez |url-status=live }}</ref> She had two children with her husband Carlos Alberto Menéndez.<ref name="Reiner-Drehwald 2009">{{Cite journal |last=Reiner-Drehwald |first=M. Magdalena |date=2010-11-01 |title=A tribute to Gabriela Hassel de Menendez (1927-2009) |url=http://www.schweizerbart.de/papers/nova_hedwigia/detail/91/75402/A_tribute_to_Gabriela_Hassel_de_Menendez_1927_2009?af=crossref |journal=Nova Hedwigia |volume=91 |issue=3-4 |pages=279–288 |doi=10.1127/0029-5035/2010/0091-0279 |issn=0029-5035 |archive-date=21 December 2024 |access-date=19 July 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241221131240/https://www.schweizerbart.de/papers/nova_hedwigia/detail/91/75402/A_tribute_to_Gabriela_Hassel_de_Menendez_1927_2009?af=crossref |url-status=live |url-access=subscription }}</ref>
